active.description: Whether or not the Secret Dependency is active.

childDependencyStatus.description: The last run status of the child Secret Dependency.

conditionDependencyId.description: The Id of the dependency that will be looked at when  Condition Mode is set to 'DEPENDENCYPASS', 'DEPENDENCYFAIL'. The Dependency must have a SortOrder lower than the current one.

conditionMode.description: Condition Mode governs if this dependency's run relies on the result of other dependencies above it. The Default is ALWAYSRUN. Other values maybe 'All Pass', 'Any Fail', 'DEPENDENCYPASS', 'DEPENDENCYFAIL'.

description.description: A description for the Secret Dependency.

groupId.description: The Id of the Dependency Group that contains the Secret Dependency.

id.description: The Id of the Secret Dependency.

logMessage.description: The last Log message for the Secret Dependency.

privilegedAccountSecretId.description: The Id of the Privileged Secret that the Secret Dependency will use to run.

secretDependencyStatus.description: The last run status of the Secret Dependency.

secretId.description: The Id of the Secret that the Secret Dependency is assigned to.

secretName.description: The Name of the Secret that the Secret Dependency is assigned to.

settings.description: The Settings used by the Secret Dependency. (Ex: WaitBeforeSeconds, Database, Port, SSHKeyDigest). If a setting exists with the same name (or intent in the case of Port and SqlPort) as a field on the Dependency template's DependencyScanItemFields collection, the value assigned to the setting takes precedence and will overwrite the corresponding DependencyScanItemField.

sortOrder.description: The sort order of the Secret Dependency in the group.  Determines the order of execution of the dependencies within a group.

sshKeySecretId.description: The Id of the Secret containing the SSH key. (If dependency is tied to SSH key Secret

sshKeySecretName.description: The Name of the Secret containing the SSH key. (If dependency is tied to SSH key Secret

typeId.description: The Id of the type of Secret Dependency.

typeName.description: The name of the type of Secret Dependency.

SecretDependencyOdbcConnectionArg.description: Connection arguments used for ODBC connections

SecretDependencyRunScript.description: The RunScript details of a Dependency that directly runs a Script

machineName.description: The machine name that the Secret Dependency runs on

odbcConnectionArguments.description: Connection arguments used for ODBC connections

scriptArguments.description: Parameter script arguments used by the script

scriptId.description: The Id of the script that the Secret Dependency runs. (If directly running a script)

scriptName.description: The Name of the script that the Secret Dependency runs.

serviceName.description: The service name of the Secret Dependency

SecretDependencyScanItemField.description: Represents the ScanItemField used for Discovery dependency matching

parentName.description: ScanItemField Parent name.  Will Match Name if no parent is inherited.

SecretDependencySetting.description: Secret Dependency Settings - Mostly used internally

canEdit.description: Indicates the setting details may be editted.

canEditValue.description: Indicates the setting value may be editted.

childSettings.description: The Child Settings that would be used  for list of options.

defaultValue.description: Default value if the setting is not given a value

isVisibile.description: Indicates the setting is visible on the UI.

parentSettingId.description: Parent Setting Id used when a setting has child options.

regexValidation.description: Regex used to validate the input

settingType.description: Type of Setting (Default (string) = 0, Integer = 1, String = 2, Boolean = 3, StringArray = 4, DropDown = 5,DropDownItem = 6

SecretDependencySettingMapForDisplay.description: Settings used by Secret Dependency Templates

changerSettingValue.description: The default read-only setting value on the changer that will be used if no setting value has been given.

settingValue.description: The value for the setting that will be stored in the database.  This value should be set when editing or creating a Dependency. If not set the default value will be calculated by looking at the Changer or Script.

SecretDependencyTemplate.description: Object filled and used for Secret Dependencies that refer to a Dependency Template

changerScriptId.description: The id of the script (if any) used by the Dependency Template

dependencyScanItemFields.description: The Scan Item Fields used by the Dependency Template

scriptName.description: The name of the script (if any) used by the Dependency Template

secretDependencyChangerId.description: The id of the Dependency Changer used by the Dependency Template

secretDependencyTemplateId.description: The id of the Dependency Template

SecretDependencyUniversalScriptArgument.description: Arguments used for Run Script Dependencies
